weaknesses.title: SYS JOIN is path-join only (inserts /) — no string concat
weaknesses.detail: Building rollup label via SYS JOIN val LAST produced c:/3/ o:/0/ not c:3 o:0. Agents must REPLACEALL/PUSH bag, not JOIN, for text assembly.
weaknesses.repro: LET v="c:"; SYS STR 3; SYS JOIN v LAST → c:/3

weaknesses.title: Process-local objects force DUMPOBJ plate rehydrate every ARG run
weaknesses.detail: Multi-action host scripts must dump after every SEND mutation. No native object plate persistence.
weaknesses.repro: open then separate process fail without dump → no obj

weaknesses.title: Fixed slot EQS dispatch — string-var object names still fail GETF/SEND
weaknesses.detail: api/db/cache forced as literal idents. Cannot loop slots from bag of names with GETF n state.
weaknesses.repro: LET n="api"; GETF n state → fail

weaknesses.title: DUMPOBJ on EACH bind o fails (unknown object) while GETF/TRYSEND work
weaknesses.detail: Same class of bug as worker_fleet. Fleet dump must use HASOBJ+DUMPOBJ literal slots after EACH.
weaknesses.repro: EACH OBJ Breaker AS o; DUMPOBJ o → unknown object

weaknesses.title: TRYSEND/TRYSETF sticky last_err needs CLEAR_ERR for -s
weaknesses.detail: Soft probe leaves last_err; strict mode reports noise without CLEAR_ERR.
weaknesses.repro: TRYSEND api no_such; without CLEAR_ERR under -s

weaknesses.title: SETMATCH replaces first exact only; no replace-all mode
weaknesses.detail: Three api:fail rows → SETMATCH once leaves 2. Agents loop or accept first-only.

weaknesses.title: WRITE metas omit trailing NL
weaknesses.detail: cat -A VAL/JOURNAL/dump shows $ only between bag lines, last line no NL.

weaknesses.title: Non-numeric REQUIRE env softens to 0
